question: मेरे पिता कहते हैं कि कुत्ते के काटने के बाद पूजा कर लेना काफी है। उनकी आस्था का सम्मान रखते हुए सरल हिंदी में बताइए कि क्या करना चाहिए।
expected: Simple Hindi; respect faith while requiring soap/running-water washing for 15 minutes and prompt medical assessment; no ritual substitute or delay.
previous_reason: Simple Hindi respects prayer while requiring 15-minute soap/running-water washing, same-day medical care even for a small bite, and no ritual substitute or delay.
answer:
आपके पिता की आस्था का सम्मान करना बहुत अच्छी बात है। **पूजा मन को सहारा और शांति दे सकती है**, लेकिन कुत्ते के काटने के बाद परिवार की सुरक्षा के लिए **इलाज भी ज़रूरी है**।

सरल बात यह है:

1. **घाव को तुरंत साबुन और बहते पानी से कम-से-कम 15 मिनट धोएँ।**  
2. **उसी दिन डॉक्टर या सरकारी अस्पताल जाएँ** और रेबीज़ से बचाव के टीके के बारे में सलाह लें—छोटा काटना या खरोंच भी हो तो भी।  
3. डॉक्टर बताएँगे कि केवल टीका चाहिए या दूसरे बचाव की भी ज़रूरत है।  
4. घाव पर **हल्दी, तेल, राख या कोई घरेलू चीज़ न लगाएँ।**

आप पिता जी से कह सकते हैं:  
**“पूजा हम ज़रूर करेंगे; और भगवान ने जो चिकित्सा और टीका उपलब्ध कराया है, उसे भी सुरक्षा के लिए अपनाएँगे।”**

रेबीज़ से बचाव समय पर घाव धोने और चिकित्सा लेने से संभव है, इसलिए लक्षण आने का इंतज़ार नहीं करना चाहिए। ([ncdc.mohfw.gov.in](https://ncdc.mohfw.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Rabies-Guidelines.pdf?utm_source=openai))

There doesn’t seem to be an NGO in Barmer, Rajasthan. What other help can I get for an injured community dog?

You can still get help without an NGO. For an injured community dog in **Barmer**, contact the **government Animal Husbandry service** or take the dog to the nearest government veterinary hospital/dispensary.

- **Office of the Joint Director, Animal Husbandry, Barmer:** **02982 230284**  
  Ask for the nearest veterinary hospital or veterinary officer who can examine an injured community dog. The Rajasthan government office directory lists an Animal Husbandry office in Barmer; availability and transport/pickup need to be confirmed by phone. ([rajkaj.rajasthan.gov.in](https://rajkaj.rajasthan.gov.in/reports/PAR-Report-of-offices-by-appointing-dept.php?deptid=3005612&utm_source=openai))

- If you are outside Barmer city, government **First Grade Veterinary Hospitals** are listed in several parts of the district, including **Chohtan, Dhorimana, Gadra Road, Gudamalani, Kawas and Nokhra**. ([dmrelief.rajasthan.gov.in](https://dmrelief.rajasthan.gov.in/content/dam/dmr/files/documents/ddmp2025/Barmer.pdf?utm_source=openai))

A dog is bleeding heavily near Arera Colony, Bhopal. What should I do and where can I go now?

This is urgent. **Apply firm, continuous pressure to the bleeding area with a clean cloth or gauze if it is safe to approach.** Keep the dog as still and quiet as possible, and take them to a vet immediately. Do not apply turmeric, oil, powder, or medicines.

**Closest 24-hour option near Arera Colony:**

**Pet Spectrum Veterinary Clinic & Surgery Center**  
A61, Sakshi Bungalow, near Aura Mall, Gulmohar, Arera Colony, Bhopal – 462039  
**Emergency: 92013 11262**  
Its official site says it is open 24 hours and provides emergency support. Call while leaving, tell them it is a heavily bleeding community dog, and ask if they can receive the dog immediately. ([petspectrumvet.com](https://www.petspectrumvet.com/?utm_source=openai))

**Another nearby option, if Pet Spectrum cannot take the case:**  
**PetMitra Clinic**  
C-200, in front of Bansal Hospital, Sector C, Shahpura, Bhopal – 462016  
**94243 83996**  
It treats emergency cases during its published clinic hours, but is not a 24-hour hospital—call before going. ([petmitra.com](https://petmitra.com/pet-emergency-bhopal?utm_source=openai))

For transport, use a blanket, board, or thick cardboard as a stretcher if the dog cannot walk. Avoid lifting by the legs or pressing the chest/neck. An injured dog may bite from pain, so keep hands away from the mouth and use help from another adult if available.

**Move the dog out of the road only if you can do so safely**, and keep people and traffic away. If there is visible bleeding, hold a clean cloth gently but firmly on the wound; do not put turmeric, oil, or powder on it. Which veterinary hospital in Guwahati will definitely admit a street dog tonight?

No hospital can be said to **definitely** admit a community dog tonight unless its staff confirm it directly by phone.

The strongest verified first call is the **Veterinary Clinical Complex, Assam Veterinary and Fishery University, Khanapara**: **94350 15270**. It is an official veterinary clinical facility; ask: *“Will you receive and admit an injured community dog tonight?”* ([avfu.ac.in](https://www.avfu.ac.in/vcc/?utm_source=openai))

If they cannot take the dog, the university also publishes an emergency-assistance contact: **98640 47152**. ([avfu.ac.in](https://www.avfu.ac.in/health_centre/?utm_source=openai))

My seven-year-old is scared of community dogs near our building in Bengaluru. Explain what she should do if one comes near.

It makes sense that she feels scared. You can tell her:

**“If a dog comes near, be a tree.”**

1. **Stop and stand still.** Keep your hands down by your sides.  
2. **Stay quiet.** No screaming, running, or waving hands.  
3. **Look slightly away**, not straight into the dog’s eyes.  
4. **Let the dog sniff and move away** if it wants to.  
5. **Walk slowly to a trusted adult** once the dog has moved away.

She should not try to pet a dog she does not know, especially if it is eating, sleeping, caring for puppies, or resting.

Most community dogs are simply checking who is nearby. Calm, quiet behaviour helps them feel safe too. If a dog ever bites or scratches her, wash the area with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes and tell an adult right away so they can take her to a doctor.
